name: RWKV-5 Eagle 7B (HF port)
notes:
head_dim stays NULL here rather than 128: config declares num_hidden_layers 32 and hidden_size 4096 but no num_attention_heads, no num_key_value_heads and no head_dim. The WKV mixer is a linear-attention recurrence with no softmax attention and no K/V projection pair, so a head dim derived as 4096/32 would be a number for a structure this model does not have. num_kv_heads, gqa_ratio and context_scaling are likewise undefined. kv_cache_bytes_per_token is 0: the recurrent state is fixed-size and context-independent. params_b is null deliberately: this repo ships pytorch_model.bin with no safetensors index and no safetensors metadata in the HF API, so the parameter count could not be machine-verified - the '7B' in the repo name is a name, not a measurement. Config facts are solid: model_type 'rwkv5', model_version '5_2', 32 layers, hidden_size 4096, head_size 64, context_length 4096, vocab 65536, and custom modeling code (trust_remote_code=True required). intermediate_size is null - RWKV5 has no separate MLP, which is why activation is also null. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 0: the WKV mixer keeps a fixed-size state vector (hidden_size x head_size per layer, rescaled every rescale_every 6 layers by a decay matrix) rather than a growing KV cache, so memory is flat in context length - but unlike Mamba-2 this is an RNN-style recurrent state, so decoding is inherently sequential and prefill is not chunk-parallel in the same way. Serving caveat from the model card: this is explicitly the transformers port for experimentation and demo use, not the production path; the native RWKV libraries and RWKV-LM v5 Eagle checkpoints are the supported route, and the README notes no instruct tune exists for it yet. context_scaling is null: context length is native to the pretrained config, no rope_scaling.

SERVICEABILITY JOIN (added 2026-10-03; the architecture x engine matrix this record was missing, with a citation per cell in docs/13-model-compatibility.md): FAMILY=recurrent.  REQUIRED KERNEL CLASS: an RNN-style WKV mixer - a fixed-size state vector (hidden_size x head_size per layer, rescaled every rescale_every 6 layers by a decay matrix) updated sequentially, with NO chunk-parallel reformulation available. This is the worst case in the repo for the flop/ssm-sequential-scan-tensor-core-mismatch problem because unlike Mamba-2 it has no SSD matrix-multiplication reformulation, so there is nothing to recover the tensor-core utilization. ENGINE JOIN: llama.cpp lists RWKV6, RWKV6QWEN2, RWKV7 and ARWKV7 in llm_arch_is_recurrent - note the gap, this engine has NO RWKV5 entry, and the checkpoint's model_type is 'rwkv5' with model_version 5_2 [[mdl2-llamacpp-arch-class-registry]] [[pap-arch-llamacpp-arch-registry]]. So on this engine's own registry the architecture is outside the recurrent family it dispatches. vLLM's architecture table has no RWKV row of any kind [[mdl2-vllm-supported-models-2026-10]]. SGLang's generative table has no RWKV entry [[mdl2-sglang-generative-models]]. TensorRT-LLM has none [[mdl2-trtllm-supported-models]]. NO ENGINE RECORD IN THIS REPO STATES RWKV SUPPORT; the honest cell for this checkpoint is UNKNOWN in docs/13-model-compatibility.md. PRACTICAL CAVEAT ALREADY IN THIS RECORD AND REINFORCED BY THE JOIN: custom modeling code is required (trust_remote_code=True), params_b is null because no safetensors metadata exists, and the model card states this is the transformers port for experimentation and demo use, not the production path.
